text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with an update on the 2022 staffing budget.

The TO Live - Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Direct that Confidential Attachment 1 and 2 to the report (August 23, 2021) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in their entirety as they are about labour relations or employee negotiations.
